subject: PRISM prepared (Ethan asked)
body: Pushed 6df1347. The 12 PRISM duplicates were exact repeats (same user/prompt/responses/answer/partition), so prepare now drops them via prefdata.drop_exact_repeats and lists each in data/prefdata/prism-splits-removed.json; conflicting or cross-partition repeats still fail build_manifest. Downloader retries 429/5xx. data/prefdata/prism-splits.json: 16,693 choices, 723 users (345 dev/378 test), manifest 037a979f, identical to the parquet snapshot at a03cab5. Arena splits.json unchanged. Revert the policy if you had decided otherwise.
